articles.title: Clarity Act odds surge on prediction markets, but crypto bill still faces long road
articles.snippet: Kalshi and Polymarket bettors sharply raised the chances of U.S. crypto market structure legislation advancing, with Tuesday's Senate vote the next test.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs near $79,000 as stocks narrow declines
articles.snippet: The Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting begins tomorrow, with nearly all now expecting the U.S. central bank to hike its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points.

articles.title: EU Regulator Says Prediction Markets Are 'Rife With Inside Trading'
articles.snippet: ESMA also asks why Kalshi and Polymarket block some EU countries but not others, and notes VPNs get around the blocks.
